hooks.command: c=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$c" | grep -qE 'vitest|npm (run )?test' && ! echo "$c" | grep -qE -- '--run|vitest run'; then echo 'vitestはwatchモードで停止します。npm test -- --run を使ってください' >&2; exit 2; fi
f=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */manifest.json) err=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq empty "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "manifest.jsonのJSON構文エラー: $err" >&2; exit 2; };; esac

input=$(cat); echo "$input" | /opt/homebrew/bin/jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain src test)" ] && exit 0; out=$(npm test -- --run 2>&1) || { echo 'テスト失敗:' >&2; echo "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; }
